# Agentiq BD

> Agentiq BD is an AI engineering and software company based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, serving clients globally. It builds AI agents ("AI Employees"), chatbots, voice AI, workflow automation, knowledge-base (RAG) applications, AI integrations, industrial AI and ERP systems, and custom software. Delivery is founder-led and hands-on.

Agentiq BD is not affiliated with NVIDIA's "AgentIQ" open-source toolkit or any other product named Agent IQ. Our domain is agentiqbd.com.

## Company facts
- Name: Agentiq BD
- Location: Pragati Sarani, Merul Badda, Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Founder: Sabbir Ahmad, Founder & AI Systems Engineer
- Email: hello@agentiqbd.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +880 1304 867542
- Languages: English (delivery, meetings, documentation)

## Services
- [AI agent development](https://www.agentiqbd.com/services/ai-agents): AI Employees for support, leads and bookings, with scoped permissions and human approval.
- [AI chatbot development](https://www.agentiqbd.com/services/chatbots): website, WhatsApp and Messenger assistants grounded in your knowledge base.
- [Voice AI agents](https://www.agentiqbd.com/services/voice): answer calls, take bookings and arrange call-backs.
- [AI workflow automation](https://www.agentiqbd.com/services/workflow-automation): automate hand-offs between tools and people.
- [Knowledge base and RAG](https://www.agentiqbd.com/services/knowledge-rag): search and Q&A over documents, policies and SOPs.
- [AI integration services](https://www.agentiqbd.com/services/integrations): connect AI to CRM, ERP, databases and messaging channels.
- [Industrial AI and ERP](https://www.agentiqbd.com/services/business-systems): procurement, inventory and production on one connected system.
- [Custom software and SaaS](https://www.agentiqbd.com/services/custom-software): web apps, SaaS, platforms and legacy modernization.
- [Dashboards and reporting](https://www.agentiqbd.com/services/reporting): dashboards and scheduled reports.

## Work and products
- [Pharmaceutical ERP](https://www.agentiqbd.com/work/pharma-erp): sourcing ERP for pharmaceutical raw materials (deployed).
- [Learning platform](https://www.agentiqbd.com/work/learning-platform): mobile-first English learning platform for Bangla speakers (deployed).
- [Marketing automation](https://www.agentiqbd.com/work/marketing-automation): automated campaign and lead follow-up workflows (deployed).
- [Matrimony platform](https://www.agentiqbd.com/work/matrimony-platform): matchmaking platform with secure sign-in, real-time chat and paid membership tiers (deployed).
- [MyPixel Guard](https://mypixelguard.agentiqbd.com): free image metadata remover that runs on the user's device (live).
- BatchPilot: management app for private tutors and coaching centres in Bangladesh (MVP, in development).
